description: Parse a document (receipt, invoice, form, ID) into structured, confidence-scored fields. Returns the ParseRelay envelope: `fields`, per-field `confidence`, `needs_review`, `field_source` provenance, and `meta` (engine, credits, tokens). Set `dry_run: true` to preview cost without spending.

dry_run.description: Preview only: returns which fields WOULD trigger a paid rescue + estimated credits, spends nothing.

engine.description: Extraction mode. Default `auto` (deterministic-first, LLM rescues only flagged fields).

image.description: The document to scan: an https URL or a base64 data URI (data:image/...;base64,...).

model_key.description: Bring your own provider key — you're billed plumbing only; the model bill is on your key.

text.description: Pre-OCR'd text supplied by the caller; no OCR is run.

ocr.description: OCR backend selection. Use backend `passthrough` with `text` to skip OCR.

anyOf.description: Field-list form — names only, e.g. ["merchant","total","date"]. Use for flat fields.

schema.description: What to extract, in ONE of two forms: a field-name array, OR a JSON Schema object with a `properties` map. Do NOT pass a flat {"field":"type"} object. Omit for a generic document.

name: scan
title: Scan a document
